gripOrHq.title: Systematic Layoffs
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Setup!
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

heapOrArchives.title: Vapor Ops
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

scoreArea.title: Security Purge
scoreArea.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

ice.title: Cortical Scrub
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

ice.title: Caryatid
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Caryatid, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.

root.title: Project Babylon
root.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

root.title: Project Zurich
root.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

removedFromGame.title: MIT West Tier
removedFromGame.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.
